design: In the new common second-round assessment, include the untouched pretrained model, each of the seven round-one terminal endpoints, each of the seven round-two terminal endpoints, each corresponding round-two validation-selected checkpoint, and the fixed-bank mutation sampler. Evaluate 3 matched seeds with the same frozen history, composition/condition requests and random streams within AR peers.
reason: Evaluate zero vs one vs two rounds under one common novel-orbit reference and proposal streams; prior round-one assessment used a different history and cannot by itself establish absolute improvement from the untouched checkpoint.
primary: Terminal weights at equal update budget; validation-selected checkpoints are a separate sensitivity.
selection_note: The anchor addition was motivated by study design after preliminary round-one outcomes were visible; it does not change training, acquisition, or select anchors based on their scores.
